message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Okay, Brad has provided the calendars for Elena and David. Now I have all four calendars and need to find a 30-minute slot where everyone is free.

I will go through the week day by day and look for a common 30-minute opening.

**Monday, Nov 16:**
*   Priya is busy: 10:00-13:00, 14:00-17:00. Free: 09:00-10:00, 13:00-14:00.
*   Marcus is busy: 10:00-11:00, 11:30-17:00. Free: 09:00-10:00, 11:00-11:30.
*   Elena is busy: 09:00-10:00, 10:30-11:00, 12:00-17:00. Free: 10:00-10:30, 11:00-12:00.
*   David is busy: 09:00-11:00, 12:00-13:00, 13:30-14:30, 15:00-17:00. Free: 11:00-12:00, 13:00-13:30, 14:30-15:00.
    *   Let's check the free slots:
        *   09:00-09:30: Priya free, Marcus free, Elena busy, David busy. No.
        *   09:30-10:00: Priya free, Marcus free, Elena busy, David busy. No.
        *   11:00-11:30: Priya busy, Marcus free, Elena free, David free. No.
*   No common slot on Monday.

**Tuesday, Nov 17:**
*   Priya is busy: 09:00-10:30, 11:00-13:00, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-16:30. Free: 10:30-11:00, 13:00-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:30-17:00.
*   Marcus is busy: 09:00-11:00, 11:30-13:00, 14:00-15:30, 16:00-16:30. Free: 11:00-11:30, 13:00-14:00, 15:30-16:00, 16:30-17:00.
*   Elena is busy: 10:00-11:00, 12:00-14:00, 14:30-17:00. Free: 09:00-10:00, 11:00-12:00, 14:00-14:30.
*   David is busy: 10:00-17:00. Free: 09:00-10:00.
    *   Let's check the free slots:
        *   09:00-09:30: Priya busy, Marcus busy, Elena free, David free. No.
        *   09:30-10:00: Priya busy, Marcus busy, Elena free, David free. No.
*   No common slot on Tuesday.

**Wednesday, Nov 18:**
*   Priya is busy: 09:00-12:30, 13:00-15:00, 16:00-17:00. Free: 12:30-13:00, 15:00-16:00.
*   Marcus is busy: 09:30-12:00, 12:30-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:00-17:00. Free: 09:00-09:30, 12:00-12:30, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-16:00.
*   Elena is busy: 09:00-09:30, 10:00-12:00, 12:30-13:00, 14:00-15:00, 15:30-17:00. Free: 09:30-10:00, 12:00-12:30, 13:00-14:00, 15:00-15:30.
*   David is busy: 09:00-11:30, 12:00-13:00, 14:00-16:00, 16:30-17:00. Free: 11:30-12:00, 13:00-14:00, 16:00-16:30.
    *   Let's check the free slots:
        *   15:00-15:30: Priya free, Marcus free, Elena free. David is busy. No.
        *   15:30-16:00: Priya free, Marcus free, Elena busy. David is busy. No.
*   No common slot on Wednesday.

**Thursday, Nov 19:**
*   Priya is busy: 09:30-10:00, 10:30-14:30, 15:00-17:00. Free: 09:00-09:30, 10:00-10:30, 14:30-15:00.
*   Marcus is busy: 09:00-10:00, 10:30-12:00, 12:30-13:30, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-17:00. Free: 10:00-10:30, 12:00-12:30, 13:30-14:00, 14:30-15:00.
*   Elena is busy: 09:00-09:30, 10:00-12:00, 12:30-14:30, 15:30-17:00. Free: 09:30-10:00, 12:00-12:30, 14:30-15:30.
*   David is busy: 09:00-09:30, 10:30-14:30, 16:00-17:00. Free: 09:30-10:30, 14:30-16:00.
    *   Let's check the free slots:
        *   14:30-15:00: Priya free, Marcus free, Elena free, David free. **Yes! This works.**

I've found a time: Thursday, November 19, from 2:30 PM to 3:00 PM (14:30-15:00).

Now I need to book it and let Brad know so he can send the confirmation. I'll create the booking and then append a message to the workspace.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
